boundary.resolution: Two sockets and independently optional ROM/RAM/mailbox; windows differ from installed capacities. Book III scope, not a completed expansion specification.

registers.resolution: Raw SELECT and derived STATUS plus four mailbox words; full bit/access/reset and source-owned write edges extracted.

datapath.resolution: Little-endian scalar storage widths, tail-zero reads, full-width RAM writes and mailbox lanes/actions; data selection differs from instruction binding.

visibility.resolution: Accepted SELECT/mailbox word writes and local IRQ/DREQ changes; DMA admission and block completion are distinct.

timing.resolution: Paired installed-model wiring establishes 33,868,800Hz and cartridge 8N+4 endpoint charges; card/card additive 16N+8 and four-word 72-cycle calculation are conditional admitted service, not a measured CPU interval or electrical rating. Unoverridden SELECT is resolved at service, not snapshotted at admission.

interrupts.resolution: Both socket source edges/central bits, local nonzero ACK and central written-one ACK remain distinct; masked-pending example.

faults.resolution: InstalledIO alignment/width and READ_ONLY 3 differ from cartridge aperture lanes/ignored actions; final aperture crossing UNMAPPED 1, shared first-fault latch and nonaborting DMA are explicit. Paired CPU ordinary alignment/fault-before-load-commit bridge prevents bus zero being mistaken for successful CPU load.

reset.resolution: SELECT0 with unchanged occupancy, mailbox0/DREQclear, cardRAM retained; fresh allocation distinguished from warm reset.

programming.resolution: Complete two-card raw-port BLua example retains socket selection, independent RAM/mailbox state, DMA override and IRQ acknowledgement. Resource-directory APIs and library/asset-packaging conventions are not cartridge hardware requirements and have been removed from this chapter.
